content: Isa Mosir zomatot ek owa
Hetolla ãi ekzon ze Malik Isar bondi, ãi tũwarare foriyad gorir, ze ḍak tũwara faiyo hiyanor laikka oi soli zibon haṛao.
Furafuri bafe norom edde sofor o, bordaš o edde dilot muhabbot raki ekzonore ekzone šoiyo.
Ruhur diya šantir bandonor duwara ek takibolla hár ḍoilla kušiš goro.
Ek ga, ek ruh, ei bafe tũwara ek aša faila, zẽtte tũwarare ḍaka oil.
Ek malik, ek biššaš ar ek torikotor gusol,
ek Allah ze beggunor Baf, ziba beggunor uwore, beggunor hãse edde beggunor butore ase.
Kintu Mosiye zendilla ṭik gori rakkil he mozin ãra fottikiyore doya gora oiye.
Hetolla hotat ase:

content.text: bondi okkolore ṭani loi za oiye,
ar hibar manuš okkolore hadiya okkol diye."

content: Bala, hiba uwore uiṭṭe, iyanor mani endilla no neki ze hiba duniyair ebbere tole laimme?
Ze nise laimme hiba ekkui zone asman beggunottuwaro aro uwore uiṭṭe, hár kissu furon goribolla.
Ar Iyan hibaye goijje, ho ekzonore asab, ar ho ekzonore nobi, ho ekzonore kušir hóbor tobolig goroya edde ho ekzonore soolsoroya edde šikoya,
zene paki manuš okkole Allar ham goribolla tiyar o, ar ei bafe Mosir ga boni uṛe,
zetodin ãra beggune Allar fuwar uwore biššaš edde giyan foijjonto ek oi fõsi no fari, edde Mosir furafuri furaiyat fõsi no fari.

Toile ãra ar gura fuwaindor ḍoilla no takiyum, manuš okkole buddi haṛaiyore oinno kiyore bul fõtot loi zaibolla ze šikka de, he bul šikka loi ãra boyare tuilla goiror ḍoil ikka edde uikka ḍulat no taki.
Ãra bolke muhabbote soyire biššaš gori edde hár kissut bari uṛi Mosir ḍoilla oi, ziba gar mata.

Hibar butore šara gagan en bafe banda ase ze fotti zura, ze zar zar zagat te taki zendilla ga loi zug take, fotti hissa zehon ṭik bafe ham gore, hetunot hara gagan matar issa loi bari uṛe edde muhabbotor duwara nizore gãti tule.
Furan edde noya manuš
Hetolla ãi hoir, edde Malikor oiyore ãi hás gori zur di hoir ze, zara Allar kalam mozin no sole he bafe tũwara zibon no haṛaiyo.
Hitarar dil andarot fori taikke. Ar hitarar dil gumra, hetolla hitara Allar babute kissu no zane, zainto o no sa. Ar hetolla Allar diya zindigittu hitara bout dure roiye.
Hitara ošar oi giyegoi edde lalsiwala oi hár ḍoilla napak ham goribolla lagam sara issar hatot nizore tulidiye.
Kintu tũwara to hendilla šikka Mosittu no fo.
Tũwara hibar babute funnila, ar hibar fũwati zug oiyore hibar butore ze soiyi ase he mozin šikka faila.
Tũwara agor ḍoilla gori no soillo, kintu furan manušware felai do, ziba nanan dúhawala issat nošto oi giyegoi.
Bolke tũwarar mone noya gori bafa sinta gorifarefan ok.
edde hibar diya noya manušore findo, ziba soiyi forhesgari edde pak fobitrota loi Allar ḍoilla oibolla sirišṭi gora oiye.
Etolla tũwara fotti ekzone misa hota bad do edde fotti kiye ekzon loi ekzone hãsa hota ho. Kiyollahoile ãra beggune ekzon loi ekzon zukto oiya.
Guššat maze guna no goijjio. Beil golibar agottu tũwarar rag fani gori felo.
Ar Šoitanore zaga no diyo.
Ze suri gore hite ar suri no gorok, bolke nizor hate halal mozin ai ruzgar gorok, zene obafi okkolore dibolla hitar hatot kissu take.
Tũwarar mukottu hono baze hota ekkan o zene no niyole, kintu zorulot mozin oinnore uwore tuli loibolla ziyan bala, šude hendilla hota okkol ho, zene zara hin fune hitarar faida o.
Tũwara Allar he Pak Ruhure duk no diyo, zare diyore Allaye tũwara uddar faibar din foijjontolla silmohor mari raka oiye.
Hár ḍoilla tita, rag edde gušša, uzoddi hoijja gora, bodnami gora edde hár ḍoilla hingša tũwarattu dur ok,
Tũwara eke ar ekzonore doya goro, eke oinnor dukke duki o, Mosir duwara Allaye tũwarare zendilla maf gori diye, tũwara o eke oinnore maf goro.
